title: Explain a Simple Digital Task

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
prompt: Describe a simple digital task you know or would like to learn. Explain the device, the steps in order, a repeated result, and one way to protect private information. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would like to prepare a document for my local club. First, I connect my device to a wireless network and open a browser. Then I visit the club website and use my own account. I type the notes with the keyboard and save a file in a folder. Before I upload the document, I check the date and the place. After I upload it, I look for the correct file name online. If the internet is unavailable, my offline copy still opens. I do not share my password in an email. When I finish, I use the logout button so that the next person cannot use my account.
